obligations.statement: The dispenser must be capable of being mounted on a wall and remaining attached during operation and refilling.
derivation_premises: A wall-mounted object must have a physical interface to the wall that resists gravity and operational forces.
Remaining attached during refilling implies the mounting must withstand loads during that scenario.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must provide a storage volume capable of holding approximately twenty items of the specified class.
derivation_premises: Items must be contained within the product boundary; a volume must be allocated.

obligations.statement: Each actuation of the lever must result in the release of exactly one item from the dispenser's storage.
derivation_premises: A lever press is a discrete user input; the mechanism must map one input to one item output.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must prevent the simultaneous release of more than one item per actuation.
derivation_premises: If two items can exit through the same aperture at the same time, they may be released together.

obligations.statement: The refilling operation must be possible from the top while the dispenser remains attached to the wall.
derivation_premises: A top opening must be present and accessible, and the mounting must permit the refilling operation.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must continue to function (not jam) when the stored quantity is low.
derivation_premises: The behavior of the item flow may change as the number of items changes; the mechanism must not obstruct that flow.

obligations.statement: An explicit definition of 'nearly empty' must be provided to assess jamming behavior.
derivation_premises: Without a quantitative threshold, the requirement cannot be verified.

obligations.statement: The behavior of the dispenser when the storage is empty or nearly empty must be specified to define 'exactly one each time'.
derivation_premises: 'Exactly one' cannot be guaranteed if no items are present; failure behavior must be defined.

candidates.summary: Gravity-fed dispenser with a rotating indexer

evidence_route_verdict.note: Configuration existence and item-to-pocket mapping can be analyzed.

candidates.summary: Gravity-fed dispenser with a gated pair

evidence_route_verdict.note: Gate timing and item separation can be analyzed.

unresolved.why_open: Multiple principle families can satisfy the requirements; the specific trade-offs are not yet visible.

assumptions.statement: The wall mounting surface is rigid and capable of supporting the dispenser.
assumptions.why: The requirement states wall-mounted, but the wall properties are not specified.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the wall is flexible or insufficiently strong.
